name: 13905 · Binghamton, NY
findings: ZIP 13905 (Binghamton) has 117 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13905 (Binghamton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13905 (Binghamton) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).
